notes: This is a new actual successful run, distinct from the earlier05925 HTTP503 dependency failure. No previous failure receipt is rewritten.

Both methods run real Android13 x86_64 JNI/Bionic PRoot and real MySQL. The Java service runs two ready/shutdown/restart cycles, rejects two duplicate starts and preserves private marker/credential identities.
Four application schemas exist empty in the bootstrap fixture; the Esteria core/updater/playerbots schemas and full ServerInstallationSetup coordinator were not executed.

The two bounded evidence archives were fully read back. Only standard HTTPS ZIP central-directory/receipt byte ranges of the229313210-byte retained-input artifact were read locally; this is not full archive SHA verification.
The905093502-byte complete source artifact was not downloaded locally. Its exact API artifact identity and the source manifest/CI complete-source retention are recorded for a later full CI consumer.
Input retention itself deliberately reports androidExecutionSucceeded=false; actual Android success is independently bound by the separate instrumentation qualification receipt.
No production ARM64 provider, application ABI or game selection changed. No initialized database, private configuration, credentials or saves are copied by this readback.
